Icons are derived from lucide-static 1.73.0, https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide, ISC licensed. See LUCIDE-LICENSE.txt.

The client-type chooser uses globe (international), store (local retail), and warehouse (local wholesale). Warehouse SVG sourced from https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/blob/main/icons/warehouse.svg on 2026-11-17. The ISC notice in LUCIDE-LICENSE.txt applies. Official references: https://lucide.dev/icons/globe, https://lucide.dev/icons/store, https://lucide.dev/icons/warehouse and https://lucide.dev/license.

Furniture specialties also use the Lucide armchair, bed-double, and monitor icons. Their SVG paths were taken from the upstream Lucide icons on 2026-11-18. The furniture coffee table, dining table, desk, and console icons use original outline artwork with the same 24 px viewBox.
